entity.name: SCP-173 The Sculpture
entity.description: A statue that moves when not observed. DO NOT BLINK.

story_attack.message: You try to strike the stone. In the blink of an eye, the statue is behind you. A sharp crack echoes through the room as your neck snaps.

lobby.name: Security Checkpoint 173
lobby.description: A reinforced foyer leading into the 173 containment unit. A guard's console sits empty.

chamber.name: Containment Chamber 173
chamber.description: A large concrete room. The floor is covered in a mixture of blood and feces. The statue stands in the center.

entity.name: SCP-106 The Old Man
entity.description: An elderly humanoid capable of passing through solid matter and dragging prey into a 'pocket dimension'.

story_run.message: The Old Man emerges from the floor beneath you. 'Going somewhere?' his eyes seem to mock. You barely dodge a decaying hand.

lobby.name: Containment Lobby 106
lobby.description: A high-security entrance. The air smells of ozone and decay.

observation.name: Monitoring Station 106
observation.description: Computers here monitor the integrity of the lead-lined walls. Static fills the screens.

chamber.name: Primary Containment Cell 106
chamber.description: A lead-lined room suspended by heavy chains. Corrosive sludge leaks from the seams.

entity.name: SCP-096 The Shy Guy
entity.description: A tall, pale humanoid. It is currently sitting in the corner, sobbing.

params.story_talk: A low, heart-wrenching sob is the only answer. It doesn't look at you.

lobby.name: Decontamination Antechamber 096
lobby.description: A sterile entrance leading to the 096 wing. Suit-up stations line the walls.

observation.name: Remote Monitoring Station 096
observation.description: The video feed is pixelated. A red warning light is flashing on the console.

chamber.name: Containment Chamber 096
chamber.description: A windowless steel cube. The crying from within is almost unbearable.
